# Declare Tracker

An issue tracker fast enough to triage a six-figure backlog: one flat
list, searched as you type, filtered, sorted, and grouped; issues open
in place for editing; create, bulk operations, and delete with undo; a
live statistics rail. Virtualization is one declaration,
`virtualize = true` on the row: the list windows, recycles, measures its
mixed-height rows, and holds its viewport steady because the runtime does
all of that; this source just declares rows over data.

The architecture, end to end:

- **One truth.** `db` holds the issues. Every mutation writes `db`, and
  every derivation re-runs because it read `db` — no clock, no ticking,
  nothing anywhere keeping view-side state about data.
- **Views are derivations.** `shown` — the projected dataset the list
  renders — derives from the truth plus the view facts (filters, query,
  sort, grouping). So do the rail's counts, the workload bars, and the
  closed-per-day chart: change the data and every number moves, because
  each one is a constraint over the same truth.
- **Search is one more filter on the projection**, never a scan of
  rendered rows. The query narrows the derived dataset exactly as a
  status chip does; Enter and the search field's arrows walk the
  narrowed rows, which materialize on arrival like any others.
- **Editing is a working copy.** An open issue edits a draft dataset
  bound with `<->`; Save commits the draft into the truth and closes,
  Cancel discards and closes — cancel is honest, and autosave is not
  pretended.
- **Selection holds records**, not indices: it survives sort flips,
  filter changes, and scrolling out of the window; regenerating the
  dataset is the only thing that clears it.

Scale: the shipped asset is 10,000 issues (~350 KB gzipped); the header's
scale control regenerates 10K / 100K / 1M in memory from the seeded
generator below — the same algorithm as tools/internal/gen-issues.mjs,
kept in sync by hand (the seed and the pools are the contract). Every
millisecond the rail reports is measured in this file, not asserted.

use [ PersonIcon ]   // the menus name their icons in data

// ── script land: plain TypeScript helpers, zero reactive machinery ────────
//
// Functions declared here are callable from `{ }` constraint bodies and
// from methods; they compute, they never store. App state lives on the
// App below; record-shaped state lives in its datasets.

script [ "tracker-data.ts" ]

schema Issue [ id: number, title: string, description: string,
    status: "open" | "in-progress" | "blocked" | "closed",
    priority: "P0" | "P1" | "P2" | "P3",
    labels[]: string, assignee?: string,
    created: number, updated: number, closedAt?: number, comments: number ]


// the tracker's own tokens, provided over the house preset in either mode:
// one color per status and per priority, the destructive red, the brand
// gradient's far stop, the white cut into filled shapes, the inks of the
// bulk bar, which inverts to the tooltip surface, and the muted tones people
// and labels are colored by — each holds white initials in both themes

theme Tracker [
    statusOpen = #45A557, statusProgress = #4C6FE7, statusBlocked = #E5484D, statusClosed = #9A9DA5,
    prioHigh = #B88024, prioMedium = #7C8698, prioLow = #AAB4BE,
    danger = #E5484D, brandTeal = #37B6A9, onFill = #FFFFFF,
    bulkLine = #666B72, bulkHover = #3A4048, bulkDanger = #FF9D9D,
    hues = [#6C7BD9, #4FA3A5, #C97B63, #8E6BC1, #5B9E5E, #C06A8C, #557FB8, #B08A4F]
    ]


// ── small pieces: the tracker's icon vocabulary ───────────────────────────
//
// One glance, no reading: status is a ring (hollow = open, dotted =
// in progress, filled = blocked, checked = done), priority is a bar
// trio, a person is an avatar. Text codes ("P2", "in-progress") retreat
// to the places prose belongs — menus and the detail panel.

class StatusIcon [ width = 14, height = 14,
    s: string = "open",
    ring: View [ x = 0, y = 0, width = 14, height = 14, cornerRadius = 7,
        fill = { s == "blocked" || s == "closed" ? app.statusColor(classroot.s) : null },
        stroke = { stroke(1.5, app.statusColor(classroot.s)) } ],
    dot: View [ visible = { s == "in-progress" }, x = 4.5, y = 4.5, width = 5, height = 5, cornerRadius = 2.5,
        fill = { app.statusColor(classroot.s) } ],
    chk: CheckIcon [ visible = { s == "closed" }, x = 1.5, y = 1.5, iconSize = 11, weight = 1.9,
        ink = { provided("theme").onFill } ],
    bang: Text [ visible = { s == "blocked" }, x = 5.5, y = 1, fontSize = 9, fontWeight = bold, wrap = false,
        textColor = { provided("theme").onFill }, text = "!" ]
    ]


class PrioIcon [ width = 13, height = 12,
    p: string = "P3",
    tooltipLabel = { p == "P0" ? "Priority · P0 Urgent" : p == "P1" ? "Priority · P1 High" : p == "P2" ? "Priority · P2 Medium" : "Priority · P3 Low" },
    lit: number = { p == "P0" || p == "P1" ? 3 : p == "P2" ? 2 : 1 },
    tone: number = { p == "P0" ? provided("theme").danger : 0 },
    b1: View [ x = 0, y = 7, width = 3, height = 5, cornerRadius = 1,
        fill = { classroot.tone != 0 ? classroot.tone : provided("theme").textMuted } ],
    b2: View [ x = 5, y = 4, width = 3, height = 8, cornerRadius = 1,
        fill = { classroot.lit >= 2 ? (classroot.tone != 0 ? classroot.tone : provided("theme").textMuted) : provided("theme").line } ],
    b3: View [ x = 10, y = 0, width = 3, height = 12, cornerRadius = 1,
        fill = { classroot.lit >= 3 ? (classroot.tone != 0 ? classroot.tone : provided("theme").textMuted) : provided("theme").line } ]
    ]


class Avatar [ width = 22, height = 22, cornerRadius = 11,
    name: string = "",
    capSize: number = 8.5,
    fill = { name == "" ? null : app.hueOf(name) },
    stroke = { name == "" ? stroke(1, provided("theme").line) : null },
    cap: TextLabel [ x = 0, textAlign = center, fontWeight = semibold, wrap = false,
        width = 100%,
        fontSize = { classroot.capSize },
        letterSpacing = 0.3,
        textColor = { classroot.name == "" ? provided("theme").textFaint : provided("theme").onFill },
        text = { classroot.name == "" ? "—" : trkInitials(classroot.name) } ]
    ]


// a label pill: a color-keyed dot and the name, outline-quiet

class Tag [ height = 18, cornerRadius = 9, padding = [0, 9, 0, 7],
    t: string = "",
    stroke = { stroke(1, provided("theme").line) },
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 4 ],
    dot: View [ y = 6, width = 6, height = 6, cornerRadius = 3, fill = { app.hueOf(t) } ],
    cap: Text [ y = 2.5, fontSize = 10.5, wrap = false,
        textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted }, text = { t } ]
    ]


// a filter chip: one value of one facet, its live count, and the on state —
// clicking toggles the facet (a Control: tab stop, Space/Enter, the ring)

class Chip extends Control [ height = 28, cornerRadius = 8, padding = [6, 12, 0, 12],
    facet: string = "",         // "status" | "assignee" | "label"
    value: string = "",
    count: number = -1,         // -1 hides the count
    on: boolean = false,
    fill = { on ? theme.controlSelected : hovered ? theme.control : null },

    // the tally is a sprung number — `Spring [ attribute = … ]` animates any
    // slot, data included, so a bulk move rolls the counts over instead of
    // snapping them. One declaration; no other wiring anywhere.

    anim: number = 0,
    Spring [ attribute = anim, to = { count < 0 ? 0 : count }, stiffness = 170, damping = 26 ],

    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 6 ],
    dot: View [ y = 5, width = 6, height = 6, cornerRadius = 3, fill = { app.statusColor(value) } ],
    cap: Text [ fontSize = 12.5, wrap = false,
        fontWeight = { classroot.on ? "semibold" : "normal" },
        textColor = { classroot.on ? theme.text : theme.textMuted },
        text = { trkStatusLabel(classroot.value) } ],
    n: Text [ y = 1, fontSize = 11, wrap = false, visible = { classroot.count >= 0 && !app.compact },
        textColor = { theme.textFaint }, text = { "" + Math.round(classroot.anim) } ],
    press() { app.toggleFilter(facet, value) }
    ]


// A list row is one of two things: an issue, or the header of a status
// group in the grouped view. Each is its own class over one base — what
// they share is TableRow's protocol, the height spring and the row fill;
// the list builds each record as the class its `kind` names.

class ListRow extends TableRow [
    exp: boolean = false,

    // Opening and closing an issue animates — the one deliberate act in the
    // list, and the motion is what says "this row became a pane" rather than
    // "the list jumped". `targetH` is the resting height; the Spring carries
    // the row to it, and its landing is when the open card is revealed —
    // the spring's own event, not a guess at its duration.
    //
    // What must **not** animate is a row revealed by scrolling. That is the
    // reconciler's business, not the author's: an instance presenting a record
    // it was not presenting before takes its geometry outright, so an expanded
    // row scrolled out and back returns at its open height with no motion,
    // and a recycled row never slides from the departed record's geometry.

    targetH: number = 44,
    height = 44,
    Spring [ attribute = height, to = { targetH }, stiffness = 320, damping = 34,
        onStop() { if (classroot.exp) app.revealOpen() }
        ],

    fill = { selected ? theme.controlSelected : hovered ? theme.surface : null },
    stroke = { active && (parent as Table).focusVisible ? stroke(1, theme.accent) : null }
    ]


// the group header — a status, its count, and the chevron that collapses
// the group; a click collapses instead of selecting

class GroupRow extends ListRow [
    targetH = 42,
    fill = { theme.background },

    hdrRow: View [ x = 0, y = 12, width = 100%, height = 24,
        // collapsed points right, open points down — one class, turned: the
        // same chevron the rest of the chrome discloses with

        chev: ChevronIcon [ x = 23, y = 3, iconSize = 11, ink = { theme.textFaint },
            dir = { app.isCollapsed("" + :status) ? "right" : "down" } ],
        d: StatusIcon [ x = 42, y = 3, s = { "" + :status } ],
        cap: Text [ x = 64, y = 2, fontSize = 13, fontWeight = semibold, wrap = false,
            text = { trkStatusLabel("" + :status) } ],
        n: Roll [ y = 3.5, fontSize = 11.5, textColor = { theme.textFaint },
            x = { this.parent.cap.x + this.parent.cap.width + 10 },
            n = { (:count ?? 0) + 0 } ]
        ],

    onClick() { if (!disabled) app.toggleGroup("" + :status) }
    ]


// the issue row — one calm line: icons carry status and priority, the
// title is the row's single strong element, everything else recedes to
// the right (labels, the avatar, the date). The row never mentions how
// many of it exist.

class IssueRow extends ListRow [
    exp = { ("" + :id) == ("" + app.expandedId) },
    targetH = { exp ? 356 : 44 },

    // ── a fixed column map, left to right ─────────────────────────────────
    //
    //   inset ▸ status ring ▸ priority bars ▸ title … labels ▸ avatar ▸ date
    //
    // `ind` is the grouped view's indent: rows tuck under their header so
    // every status ring hangs on one vertical line.

    ind: number = { app.groupBy == "status" ? 18 : 0 },
    colStat: number = { 24 + ind },      // the status ring's left edge
    colPrio: number = { 50 + ind },      // the priority bars'
    colTitle: number = { 76 + ind },     // the title's

    // the row's one line — the top 44px, whatever height the row springs to

    line: View [ width = 100%, height = 44, padding = [0, 24, 0, 0],
        stat: StatusIcon [ y = center, x = { classroot.colStat }, s = { "" + :status } ],
        prio: PrioIcon [ y = center, x = { classroot.colPrio }, p = { "" + :priority } ],

        // an over-long title ellipsizes rather than being cut mid-glyph by the clip

        title: Text [ y = center, fontSize = 13.5, wrap = false, maxLines = 1,
            x = { classroot.colTitle },
            width = { parent.meta.x - this.x - 16 },
            text = { "" + :title } ],

        // labels, assignee and date, flush right

        meta: View [ x = end, y = center,
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 12, align = center ],

            // the first two labels ride inline (slice replication); "+n" carries
            // the rest — the detail panel shows them all

            tags: View [ visible = { !app.compact && (:labels ?? []).length > 0 },
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 6, align = center ],
                Tag [ datapath = :labels[0:2][], t = { "" + :@ } ],
                more: Text [ fontSize = 10.5, wrap = false, visible = { (:labels ?? []).length > 2 },
                    textColor = { theme.textFaint },
                    text = { "+" + ((:labels ?? []).length - 2) } ]
                ],
            avatar: Avatar [ name = { "" + (:assignee ?? "") } ],
            when: Text [ fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textAlign = right, width = 40,
                textColor = { theme.textFaint },
                text = { trkDate(:updated ?? 0) } ]
            ]
        ],

    // selection announces itself with the accent bar, not a heavy fill

    bar: View [ visible = { parent.selected && !parent.exp }, x = 0, y = 6, width = 3, cornerRadius = 1.5,
        height = { Math.min(parent.height, 44) - 12 },
        fill = { theme.accent } ],

    // the open-in-place editor: rides below the row's own line while the
    // height spring makes room; absorbs clicks so the row doesn't toggle.
    // It exists only on the open row — a hidden editor in every row would be
    // most of what the list builds.

    card: EditorCard [ exists = { classroot.exp }, x = 12, y = 48, clip = true,
        width = { parent.width - 24 },
        height = { Math.max(0, parent.height - 56) },
        fill = { theme.surface }, cornerRadius = 10,
        stroke = { stroke(1, theme.line) },
        shadow = { shadow(0, 4, 16, 0x00000018) },
        onClick() { }
        ],

    // an issue row keeps TableRow's whole selection protocol and adds the
    // context menu

    onClick() {
        if (disabled) return
        if (exp) { app.closeDetail(); return }
        super.onClick()
        app.openDetail()
        },

    onContextMenu(e: PointerEvent) { app.rowMenu(this, e) },
    onHold(e: PointerEvent) { app.rowMenu(this, e) }
    ]


// a person's avatar as a menu icon — created into the standard icon
// column (`iconKind`), so person rows keep the settled anatomy: check
// column, icon column, labels on one text edge

class PersonIcon extends Avatar [ width = 16, height = 16, cornerRadius = 8, capSize = 6.5,
    name = { "" + :name }
    ]


// a rolling number — the rail's working unit: a Spring on the value itself

class Roll extends Text [ wrap = false,
    n: number = 0,
    anim: number = 0,
    Spring [ attribute = anim, to = { n }, stiffness = 170, damping = 26 ],
    text = { Math.round(anim).toLocaleString() }
    ]


// one rail statistic: status icon or avatar, a name, a bar, a rolling count.
// The row **is** a filter — clicking it toggles the facet it counts.

class RailStat extends Control [ height = 30, cornerRadius = 7,
    width = { app.railW - 40 },
    facet: string = "",
    value: string = "",
    cap: string = "",
    n: number = 0,
    peak: number = 1,
    tint: number = 0,
    hueName: string = "",
    tintUse: number = { hueName != "" ? app.hueOf(hueName) : tint },
    on: boolean = false,
    fill = { on ? theme.controlSelected : hovered ? theme.control : null },
    name: Text [ x = 30, y = center, fontSize = 12.5, wrap = false, maxLines = 1, width = 92,
        fontWeight = { classroot.on ? "semibold" : "normal" },
        textColor = { classroot.on ? theme.text : theme.textMuted },
        text = { classroot.cap } ],
    track: View [ x = 128, y = 13, height = 4, cornerRadius = 2,
        width = { classroot.width - 128 - 54 },
        fill = { theme.control },
        fillbar: View [ x = 0, y = 0, height = 4, cornerRadius = 2,
            width = { Math.max(2, parent.width * classroot.n / Math.max(1, classroot.peak)) },
            fill = { classroot.tintUse != 0 ? classroot.tintUse : theme.accent } ]
        ],
    num: Roll [ y = center, fontSize = 12, textAlign = right, width = 44,
        x = { parent.width - 48 },
        textColor = { theme.textMuted },
        n = { classroot.n } ],
    press() { app.toggleFilter(facet, value) }
    ]


// one line of the rail's keyboard legend: the key, and what it does

class KeyHint [ width = 100%, height = 18,
    shortcut: string = "",
    what: string = "",
    k: Text [ y = 1, fontSize = 10.5, textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted }, text = { classroot.shortcut } ],
    v: Text [ x = 44, y = 1, fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }, text = { classroot.what } ]
    ]


// the undo toast — one at a time, rises from the bottom, waits eight
// seconds, honors its word

class Toast [ visible = { shown || lift > 0.02 }, height = 40, cornerRadius = 10,
    shown: boolean = false,
    msg: string = "",
    gen: number = 0,
    lift: number = 0,
    Spring [ attribute = lift, to = { shown ? 1 : 0 }, stiffness = 260, damping = 26 ],
    opacity = { lift },
    padding = [0, 20, 0, 16],
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 10 ],
    fill = { provided("theme").tooltipFill },
    shadow = { shadow(0, 6, 24, 0x00000040) },
    cap: TextLabel [ fontSize = 12.5, wrap = false,
        textColor = { provided("theme").tooltipTextColor }, text = { msg } ],
    u: Control [ y = 7, height = 26, cornerRadius = 7,
        width = { this.t.width + 18 },
        fill = { hovered || pressed ? theme.accent : null },
        t: Text [ x = 9, y = center, fontSize = 12, fontWeight = semibold, wrap = false,
            textColor = { this.parent.hovered || this.parent.pressed ? theme.accentTextColor : theme.accent }, text = "Undo" ],
        press() { app.undoDelete() }
        ],
    show(m: string) {
        msg = m
        shown = true
        this.raise()
        gen = gen + 1
        const g = gen
        afterDelay(8000, () => { if (this.gen == g) this.shown = false })
        },
    hide() { gen = gen + 1; shown = false }
    ]


// an editable label tag for the detail panel — the list Tag plus a remove ×

class EditTag [ height = 22, cornerRadius = 7, padding = [4, 10, 0, 8],
    t: string = "",
    fill = { provided("theme").control },
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 4 ],
    cap: Text [ fontSize = 11.5, textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted }, text = { t } ],
    x2: Text [ fontSize = 11, textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }, text = "×",
        onClick() {
            const ls = (app.draft.value.it?.labels ?? []).filter((l) => l != classroot.t)
            app.setDraftField("labels", ls)
            }
        ]
    ]


// the in-place editor — an issue edits where it lives. The card binds the
// draft dataset (Save commits and closes, Cancel discards and closes);
// the host row's height springs open around it, and the windowed kernel's
// measured ladder carries the animation, so the rows below glide out of
// the way. One class, two hosts: the expanded row, and the New-issue
// strip above the list.

class EditorCard [
    datapath = { app.draft.value },

    // the card's own content box — the column is simply the room inside it

    padding = [12, 16, 12, 16],

    col: View [ width = 100%,
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 12 ],

        titleF: TextInput [ width = 100%, height = 36, fontSize = 16, fontWeight = semibold,
            text <-> :it.title,
            placeholder = "Issue title" ],

        facets: View [ width = 100%, height = 28,
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 8 ],
            st: Facet [ field = "status", value = { trkStatusLabel("" + (:it.status ?? "open")) }, tint = { app.statusColor("" + (:it.status ?? "open")) } ],
            pr: Facet [ field = "priority", value = { "" + (:it.priority ?? "P2") }, tint = { app.prioColor("" + (:it.priority ?? "P2")) } ],
            as: Facet [ field = "assignee", value = { (:it.assignee ?? "Unassigned") + "" } ]
            ],

        // the tags wrap; the band is as tall as they make it — a container
        // sizes itself from its content, so there is no height to state

        labels: View [ width = 100%,
            layout: WrappingLayout [ spacing = 6 ],
            EditTag [ datapath = :it.labels[], t = { "" + :@ } ],
            add: Control [ height = 22, cornerRadius = 7, width = 26,
                fill = { hovered ? theme.control : null },
                stroke = { stroke(1, theme.line) },
                t: Text [ x = 8, y = 3, fontSize = 12, textColor = { theme.textMuted }, text = "+" ],
                menu = { app.addLabelMenu }
                ]
            ],

        descF: TextInput [ width = 100%, height = 84, fontSize = 16, multiline = true, wrap = true,
            text <-> :it.description,
            placeholder = "Add a description…" ],

        // One row, one baseline. Every control here is the same height and
        // centers its label's caps, so the same-sized labels (the buttons' and
        // Delete's) share a baseline by construction; the smaller meta line
        // sits its own baseline on Save's declared one.

        foot: View [ width = 100%, height = { app.footRowH },
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 10, align = baseline ],
            save: Button [ width = 96, height = { app.footRowH }, label = { app.creating ? "Create" : "Save" }, primary = true,
                disabled = { !app.draftDirty },
                onClick() { if (!disabled) app.commitDraft() }
                ],
            cancel: Button [ width = 84, height = { app.footRowH }, label = "Cancel",
                onClick() { app.closeDetail() }
                ],
            meta: Text [ fontSize = 11, wrap = false, textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }, visible = { !app.creating },
                text = { "Created " + trkDate(:it.created ?? 0) + " · Updated " + trkDate(:it.updated ?? 0) + " · " + ("" + (:it.comments ?? 0)) + " comments" } ],
            sp: Spacer [ ],

            // the destructive action wears the same button as its neighbours and
            // says what it is in its ink and outline

            del: Button [ width = 84, height = { app.footRowH }, visible = { !app.creating }, label = "Delete…",
                inkColor = { provided("theme").danger }, stroke = { stroke(1, provided("theme").danger) },
                onClick() { app.deleteSelection() }
                ]
            ]
        ]
    ]


// one editable facet button in the editor card: the current value and a
// chevron; press opens the shared options menu for its field

class Facet extends Control [ height = 28, cornerRadius = 7, padding = { [0, 6, 0, tint != 0 ? 9 : 10] },
    field: string = "",
    value: string = "",
    tint: number = 0,
    fill = { hovered || pressed ? theme.control : null },
    stroke = { stroke(1, theme.line) },
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 6 ],
    dot: View [ visible = { tint != 0 }, y = 10, width = 8, height = 8, cornerRadius = 4, fill = { tint } ],
    v: Text [ y = center, fontSize = 12.5, wrap = false, text = { value } ],
    arr: ChevronIcon [ iconSize = 11, ink = { theme.textMuted } ],
    menu = { app.facetMenu },
    press() { app.facetField = field; super.press() }
    ]


App [ fill = { provided("theme").background }, textColor = { provided("theme").text }, minWidth = 320, appName = "Declare Tracker",

    // ── the responsive facts ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    compact: boolean = { app.width < 640 },      // the bar: brand compacts, omnibox shrinks

    barH: number = 56,
    footRowH: number = 32,        // the editor footer's one row height
    railW: number = 300,
    railOn: boolean = { app.width >= 1100 },     // below this the rail yields to the list

    // ── the chrome facts (the flagship family conventions) ─────────────────

    themeMode: string = "auto",
    darkUI: boolean = { themeMode == "dark" || (themeMode == "auto" && app.dark) },
    theme = { { ...(app.darkUI ? SanFranciscoDark : SanFrancisco), ...Tracker } },

    // a status, a priority or a name, as its color

    hueOf(name: string) -> number {
        const hues = provided("theme").hues
        return hues[trkHash(name) % hues.length]
        },

    statusColor(s: string) -> number {
        const t = provided("theme")
        return s == "open" ? t.statusOpen : s == "in-progress" ? t.statusProgress : s == "blocked" ? t.statusBlocked : t.statusClosed
        },
    prioColor(p: string) -> number {
        const t = provided("theme")
        return p == "P0" ? t.danger : p == "P1" ? t.prioHigh : p == "P2" ? t.prioMedium : t.prioLow
        },

    // ── the truth ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    //
    // `db` holds the issues, and that is the whole of it: a verb writes db and
    // every projection that read db re-runs. Nothing else anywhere holds data.
    //
    // It is a working copy, not the source itself, because the issues come
    // from more than one fetch: the regenerate control replaces them, and a
    // source's value is replaced whole by every fetch. Edits live in db, and
    // `adopt` is the one place a new batch arrives.
    //
    // No change counter is threaded through anything: the compiler reads
    // through method bodies, so a projection that calls `issuesOf` is wired
    // to the issues list with no help, and re-derives on every insert,
    // removeAt, and set.

    db: Dataset [ schema = [ issues[]: Issue ] ] { { "issues": [] } },

    src: DataSource [ url = "issues.json", schema = [ issues[]: Issue ],
        onLoad() { app.landed() }
        ],

    booted: boolean = { src.loaded },
    askedAt: number = 0,
    loadMs: number = 0,
    adoptMs: number = 0,

    onInit() {

        src.fetch()

    adopt(issues: array) {
        db.set(["issues"], issues)

    // Regenerating a million issues holds the main thread for seconds. The
    // press returns at once, so its own settle paints — the control shows the
    // new choice — and the work runs on the next frame.

    regenerate(count: number) {
        if (this.generating) return
        this.generating = true
        afterDelay(0, () => {
            const t0 = trkNow()
            const issues = trkGenerate(count)
            const t1 = trkNow()
            this.adopt(issues)
            this.loadMs = Math.round(t1 - t0)
            this.adoptMs = Math.round(trkNow() - t1)

    // ── the view facts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    sortOn: string = "updated",
    sortDir: string = "desc",
    groupBy: string = "none",                    // none | status
    fStatus: string = "",                        // "" = no filter
    fAssignee: string = "",
    fLabel: string = "",

    // A filter, sort, query or grouping change is a new arrangement, not an
    // edit to the old one, so the list starts it at the top. Every writer of
    // one of these gets that, and no writer has to remember to ask.

    trackChanges = ["fStatus", "fAssignee", "fLabel", "query", "sortOn", "sortDir", "groupBy"],

    onChange(e: ChangeEvent) { this.body.main.list.scrollTo(0) },

    // Is the keyboard owned by a text field? A bare-character shortcut must
    // never steal a keystroke from one: the search box, or the open editor.

    typing: boolean = { app.editing || app.bar.search.omni.focused },

    clearAll() {
        fStatus = ""; fAssignee = ""; fLabel = ""; query = ""
        },

    toggleFilter(facet: string, value: string) {
        if (facet == "status") fStatus = fStatus == value ? "" : value
        else if (facet == "assignee") fAssignee = fAssignee == value ? "" : value
        else if (facet == "label") fLabel = fLabel == value ? "" : value
        },

    setSort(field: string) {
        if (sortOn != field) { sortOn = field; sortDir = field == "title" ? "asc" : "desc" }
        },

    toggleSortDir() {
        sortDir = sortDir == "desc" ? "asc" : "desc"
        },

    // collapsed groups — a reactive slot, replaced whole on every toggle so
    // each reader (the header chevrons, the projection) wakes on its own

    collapsed: string[] = [],
    isCollapsed(s: string) -> boolean { return collapsed.includes(s) },
    toggleGroup(s: string) {
        collapsed = collapsed.includes(s) ? collapsed.filter((x) => x != s) : [...collapsed, s]
        },

    // ── the projection — the one derived dataset the list renders.
    //    filter → sort → (group); group headers are records too ({ kind:
    //    "hdr" }) — non-uniform rows are just rows.
    //
    //    The arguments are the view facts, and they are arguments because that
    //    reads well, not because the wiring needs them: the body could read
    //    `app.query` directly and wire identically. The data is not among them
    //    — `project` reaches it through `issuesOf`, and the compiler follows
    //    the call. ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    shown: Dataset [ contents = { app.project(app.fStatus, app.fAssignee, app.fLabel, app.query, app.sortOn, app.sortDir, app.groupBy) } ],

    issuesOf() -> Issue[] { return db.read(["issues"]) ?? [] },

    project(byStatus: string, byAssignee: string, byLabel: string, query: string, sortOn: string, sortDir: string, grouping: string) -> object {
        let rows = this.issuesOf()
        if (byStatus != "" || byAssignee != "" || byLabel != "") {
            rows = rows.filter((it) =>
                (byStatus == "" || it.status == byStatus) &&
                (byAssignee == "" || it.assignee == byAssignee) &&
                (byLabel == "" || (it.labels ?? []).includes(byLabel)))
            }
        // the query narrows like any other filter (a tracker searches by
        // hiding what doesn't match, not by bolding what does); the scan is
        // timed and the number rides out with the value — pure, no clocks
        let searchMs = 0
        if (query.trim() != "") {
            const t0 = trkNow()
            const needle = query.trim().toLowerCase()
            rows = rows.filter((it) => trkHaystack(it).includes(needle))
            searchMs = Math.max(0, Math.round((trkNow() - t0) * 10) / 10)
            }
        // Every comparator is ascending — least-interesting first: oldest,
        // lowest priority, A→Z. `desc` then reverses, uniformly, with no key
        // carrying a special case (so a new sort field inherits the rule).
        const RANK = ({ P0: 3, P1: 2, P2: 1, P3: 0 })
        const asc = sortOn == "priority" ? (a, b) => RANK[a.priority] - RANK[b.priority] || a.updated - b.updated
            : sortOn == "title" ? (a, b) => (a.title < b.title ? -1 : a.title > b.title ? 1 : 0)
            : (a, b) => a.updated - b.updated
        rows = [...rows].sort(sortDir == "desc" ? (a, b) => asc(b, a) : asc)
        if (grouping != "status") return ({ rows: rows, total: rows.length, searchMs: searchMs })
        const out = []
        for (const st of this.statuses) {
            const members = rows.filter((it) => it.status == st)
            if (members.length == 0) continue
            out.push(({ kind: "hdr", id: "hdr:" + st, status: st, count: members.length }))
            if (!this.isCollapsed(st)) out.push(...members)
            }
        return ({ rows: out, total: rows.length, searchMs: searchMs })
        },

    // the four statuses, in workflow order — the chips, the rail and the
    // grouped view all list them in this order

    statuses: string[] = ["open", "in-progress", "blocked", "closed"],

    statusRows: Dataset [ contents = { { rows: app.statusCounts() } } ],

    closedSeries: Dataset [ contents = { app.closedPerDay() } ],
    closedPerDay() -> object {
        const DAY = 86400000
        let maxU = 0
        const issues = this.issuesOf()
        for (const it of issues) if ((it.updated ?? 0) > maxU) maxU = it.updated
        const today = Math.floor(maxU / DAY)
        const days = new Array(14).fill(0)
        for (const it of issues) {
            const c = it.closedAt
            if (c == null) continue
            const d = today - Math.floor(c / DAY)
            if (d >= 0 && d < 14) days[13 - d] = days[13 - d] + 1
            }
        return ({ days: days, peak: Math.max(1, ...days) })
        },
    statusCounts() -> array {
        const n = new Map()
        for (const it of this.issuesOf()) n.set(it.status, (n.get(it.status) ?? 0) + 1)
        return this.statuses.map((s) => ({ status: s, n: n.get(s) ?? 0 }))
        },

    shownTotal: number = { app.shown.value.total ?? 0 },

    workload: Dataset [ contents = { app.workloadOf() } ],
    workloadOf() -> object {
        const m = new Map()
        let un = 0
        for (const it of this.issuesOf()) {
            if (("" + it.status) == "closed") continue
            const a = it.assignee
            if (a == null) un = un + 1
            else m.set(a, (m.get(a) ?? 0) + 1)
            }
        const top = [...m.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 6)
        const peak = Math.max(1, un, ...top.map((e) => e[1]))
        // peak rides on each row (a row's cursor sees its own record, not
        // the root) — the view-model fact lands where the view reads it
        const rows = top.map((e) => ({ name: e[0], n: e[1], peak: peak }))
        return ({ rows: [...rows, ({ name: "", n: un, peak: peak })] })
        },

    //    list (typing hides the non-matches; clearing restores). Enter and
    //    the omnibox arrows walk the narrowed rows; Enter opens the walked

    query: string = "",

    stepHit(d: number) {
        const rows = (this.shown.value.rows ?? [])
        if (rows.length == 0) return
        let j = this.selected != null ? rows.indexOf(this.selected) : (d > 0 ? -1 : rows.length)
        do { j = j + d } while (j >= 0 && j < rows.length && rows[j].kind == "hdr")
        if (j < 0 || j >= rows.length) return
        this.takeSelection([rows[j]])
        this.body.main.list.showRow(j)
        this.body.main.list.activeIndex = j
        this.body.main.list.active = rows[j]
        },

    enterHit() {
        if (this.selected == null) this.stepHit(1)
        if (this.selected != null) this.openDetail()

        // issue's fields. The draft is one slot, so an in-flight edit is
        // discarded here, and equally when you open a different issue.
        else if (editing && clean.length == 1) this.seedDraft()

    // reach the truth until Save. Every path that changes which issue is open
    // goes through here, which is the whole point: the draft must follow the
    // expanded row or the editor shows one issue's fields inside another
    // issue's row.

        if (selected == null) return
        draft.set(["it"], ({ ...selected, labels: [...selected.labels] }))

        if (selected == null || selCount != 1) return

        this.seedDraft()

        this.takeSelection(null)

        editing = true

    // field edit — typed into a `<->` field or set by a facet — so Save

    draftDirty: boolean = { app.editing && app.draftDiffers() },
    draftDiffers() -> boolean {
        const d = draft.read(["it"])
        if (d == null) return false
        if (creating) return true
        const t = this.issuesOf().find((it) => it.id == d.id)
        if (t == null) return true
        return d.title != t.title || d.description != t.description || d.status != t.status ||
            d.priority != t.priority || d.assignee != t.assignee || JSON.stringify(d.labels) != JSON.stringify(t.labels)
        },

    commitDraft() {
        const d = draft.value.it
        if (d == null) return
        if (creating) {
            db.insert(["issues"], 0, ({ ...d }))
            const rec = this.issuesOf()[0]
            this.takeSelection([rec])
            creating = false
            editing = false
            return
            }
        const issues = this.issuesOf()
        const i = issues.findIndex((it) => it.id == d.id)
        if (i < 0) return
        db.set(["issues", i, "title"], d.title)
        db.set(["issues", i, "description"], d.description)
        db.set(["issues", i, "status"], d.status)
        db.set(["issues", i, "priority"], d.priority)
        db.set(["issues", i, "assignee"], d.assignee)
        db.set(["issues", i, "labels"], [...d.labels])
        const up2 = d.updated + 1
        db.set(["issues", i, "updated"], up2)
        db.set(["issues", i, "closedAt"], d.status == "closed" ? up2 : null)
        editing = false
        },

        draft.set(["it", field], v)

    // ── mutation verbs — every write to the truth lives here ──────────────
    //

    // (closedAt). That is all a verb does — there is nothing to notify, because
    // every projection already read `db`. Nothing else in the file mutates

    // the people who actually hold work — the truth decides who is listed

    assignees() -> array {
        return [...new Set(this.issuesOf().map((it) => it.assignee).filter((a) => a != null))].sort()
        },

    // No confirmation dialog: the undo toast is the safety net, and a modal

    deleteSelection() {
        if (selCount > 0) this.performDelete()
        },

    lastDeleted: array = [],            // what Undo puts back: { index, rec } per removed issue; empty = nothing to undo

    performDelete() {
        const issues = this.issuesOf()
        const removed = selection.map((r) => ({ index: issues.findIndex((it) => it.id == r.id), rec: r }))
            .filter((r) => r.index >= 0).sort((a, b) => b.index - a.index)
        for (const r of removed) db.removeAt(["issues"], r.index)
        lastDeleted = removed
        this.takeSelection(null)
        this.toast.show(removed.length == 1 ? "Deleted 1 issue" : "Deleted " + removed.length + " issues")
        },

    undoDelete() {
        const u = lastDeleted
        if (u.length == 0) return
        const back = [...u].sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index)
        for (const r of back) db.insert(["issues"], Math.min(r.index, this.issuesOf().length), r.rec)
        lastDeleted = []
        this.takeSelection(back.map((r) => r.rec))
        this.toast.hide()
        },

            const up = issues[i].updated + 1
            db.set(["issues", i, "updated"], up)
            if (field == "status") db.set(["issues", i, "closedAt"], v == "closed" ? up : null)
            }
        },

        chips: View [ height = 28, flexes = true,

            assigneeBtn: Control [ height = 28, cornerRadius = 8, padding = [0, 4, 0, 13],

    // ── the list — a windowed Table over the projection ───────────────────
    //
    // `virtualize = true` is the whole virtualization story: the runtime
    // windows, recycles, and measures rows (including one springing open
    // into the editor card) with no further instruction from this file.

    // which row is open in place: an issue edits where it lives — the
    // row's height springs open and the kernel's measured ladder carries
    // the animation through the windowed list

    expandedId: number = { app.editing && !app.creating && app.selCount == 1 && app.selected != null ? app.selected.id : -1 },

    // ── the body — the issues and the rail, in what the bar, the toolbar
    //    and the footer leave ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    body: View [ width = 100%, flexes = true,
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x ],

        // the main column: the new-issue form while one is being written,
        // then the list, which takes the rest; the empty state and the bulk
        // bar float over it

        main: View [ height = 100%, flexes = true,
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y ],

            creator: View [ visible = { app.creating }, width = 100%, padding = [8, 24, 8, 24],
                sheet: View [ width = 100%, height = 340, clip = true,
                    fill = { provided("theme").surface }, cornerRadius = 10,
                    stroke = { stroke(1, provided("theme").line) },
                    shadow = { shadow(0, 4, 16, 0x00000018) },
                    card: EditorCard [ width = 100% ]
                    ]
                ],

            // The list. Rows over the projection; every hard thing about scale is
            // someone else's honest work. It takes the column's rest, up to a
            // reading width.

            list: Table [ width = { Math.min(parent.width, 1460) }, flexes = true,
                datapath = { app.shown.value },
                selects = "multi",
                selected = { app.selected },
                selection = { app.selection },
                input(sel: array) { app.takeSelection(sel) },
                deleteRequested() { app.deleteSelection() },
                activateRequested() { app.openDetail() },
                ListRow [ datapath = :rows[], virtualize = true,
                    classFor = { :kind == "hdr" ? GroupRow : IssueRow } ]
                ],

            // the empty state says why it is empty — an overlay, centred on the list

            empty: View [ visible = { app.booted && app.shownTotal == 0 }, width = 280, ignoreLayout = true,
                x = { (parent.list.width - this.width) / 2 },
                pop: number = 0,
                Spring [ attribute = pop, to = { app.booted && app.shownTotal == 0 ? 1 : 0 }, stiffness = 220, damping = 26 ],
                opacity = { this.pop },
                y = { 120 + (1 - this.pop) * 14 },
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 12 ],
                ring: View [ x = center, width = 36, height = 36, cornerRadius = 18,
                    stroke = { stroke(2, provided("theme").line) },
                    g: Text [ x = 0, y = center, width = 36, textAlign = center, fontSize = 15, textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }, text = "?" ]
                    ],
                cap: Text [ width = 280, textAlign = center, fontSize = 14.5, fontWeight = semibold,
                    text = { app.issuesOf().length == 0 ? "No issues yet" : "No issues match" } ],
                sub: Text [ width = 280, textAlign = center, fontSize = 12.5, textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted },
                    text = { app.issuesOf().length == 0
                        ? "Create the first one — New issue is waiting."
                        : "Try a different search, or clear the filters." } ],
                clear: Button [ x = center, height = 30, fontSize = 12.5, label = "Clear all",
                    visible = { app.issuesOf().length > 0 },
                    onClick() { app.clearAll() }
                    ]
                ],

            bulk: View [ height = 44, cornerRadius = 12, ignoreLayout = true,
                visible = { app.selCount > 1 || this.lift > 0.02 },

                // the bar inverts to the tooltip surface, with the bulk inks on it

                lift: number = 0,
                Spring [ attribute = lift, to = { app.selCount > 1 ? 1 : 0 }, stiffness = 260, damping = 26 ],
                opacity = { lift },
                padding = [8, 16, 8, 16],
                x = { (parent.list.width - this.width) / 2 },
                y = { parent.height - 60 + (1 - this.lift) * 20 },
                fill = { provided("theme").tooltipFill },
                shadow = { shadow(0, 8, 28, 0x00000050) },
                row: View [ height = 28,
                    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 14 ],
                    cnt: View [ height = 28,
                        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 6 ],
                        t: Roll [ y = center, fontSize = 13, fontWeight = semibold,
                            textColor = { provided("theme").tooltipTextColor }, n = { app.selCount } ],
                        l: Text [ y = center, fontSize = 13, wrap = false,
                            textColor = { provided("theme").tooltipTextColor }, text = "selected" ]
                        ],
                    div1: View [ width = 1, height = 20, y = 4, fill = { provided("theme").bulkLine } ],
                    act: Control [ height = 28, cornerRadius = 7, width = { this.t.width + 20 },
                        fill = { hovered ? provided("theme").bulkHover : null },
                        t: Text [ x = 10, y = center, fontSize = 12.5, wrap = false,
                            textColor = { theme.tooltipTextColor }, text = "Set status ▾" ],
                        menu = { app.bulkMenu }
                        ],
                    del: Control [ height = 28, cornerRadius = 7, width = { this.t.width + 20 },
                        fill = { hovered || pressed ? provided("theme").danger : null },
                        t: TextLabel [ x = 10, fontSize = 12.5, fontWeight = semibold, wrap = false,
                            textColor = { this.parent.hovered || this.parent.pressed ? provided("theme").onFill : provided("theme").bulkDanger }, text = "Delete…" ],
                        press() { app.deleteSelection() }
                        ],
                    div2: View [ width = 1, height = 20, y = 4, fill = { provided("theme").bulkLine } ],
                    clr: Control [ height = 28, cornerRadius = 7, width = 28,
                        fill = { hovered ? provided("theme").bulkHover : null },
                        t: Text [ x = 0, y = center, width = 28, textAlign = center, fontSize = 13,
                            textColor = { theme.tooltipTextColor }, text = "×" ],
                        press() { app.takeSelection(null) }
                        ]
                    ]
                ]
            ],

        // ── the rail: an instrument, not a sidebar. Every number below is a
        //    live derivation off the one truth; every row is also a filter. ─────

        rail: View [ visible = { app.railOn }, width = { app.railW }, height = 100%, clip = true, scrolls = y,
            padding = 20, stroke = { [null, null, null, stroke(1, provided("theme").line)] },

            col: View [ width = 100%,
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 22 ],

                hero: View [ width = 100%, height = 66,
                    n: Roll [ x = 0, y = 0, fontSize = 38, fontWeight = bold, letterSpacing = -1,
                        textFill = { gradient("90deg", provided("theme").accent, provided("theme").brandTeal) },
                        n = { app.shownTotal } ],
                    cap: Text [ x = 2, y = 48, fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint },
                        text = { app.shownTotal == app.issuesOf().length
                            ? "issues · nothing filtered out"
                            : "matching · of " + app.issuesOf().length.toLocaleString() + " issues" } ]
                    ],

                byStatus: View [ width = 100%,
                    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 2 ],
                    cap: Text [ fontSize = 11, fontWeight = semibold, letterSpacing = 0.6, wrap = false,
                        textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }, text = "BY STATUS" ],
                    gap: View [ width = 1, height = 6 ],

                    // one band, each status's share of it in its color

                    dist: View [ width = 100%, height = 6, cornerRadius = 3, clip = true,
                        datapath = { app.statusRows.value },
                        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x ],
                        View [ datapath = :rows[], height = 6, fill = { app.statusColor(:status) },
                            width = { parent.width * :n / Math.max(1, app.issuesOf().length) } ]

                    gap2: View [ width = 1, height = 8 ],
                    rows: View [ width = 100%, datapath = { app.statusRows.value },
                        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 2 ],
                        RailStat [ datapath = :rows[], width = 100%, facet = "status", value = :status, cap = { trkStatusLabel(:status) },
                            n = :n, peak = { app.issuesOf().length }, tint = { app.statusColor(:status) },
                            on = { app.fStatus == :status },
                            ic: StatusIcon [ x = 8, y = 8, s = :status ]
                            ]
                        ]
                    ],

                work: View [ width = 100%,
                    datapath = { app.workload.value },
                    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 2 ],
                    cap: Text [ fontSize = 11, fontWeight = semibold, letterSpacing = 0.6, wrap = false,
                        textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }, text = "WORKLOAD · OPEN WORK" ],
                    gap: View [ width = 1, height = 6 ],
                    RailStat [ datapath = :rows[], width = 100%,
                        facet = "assignee",
                        value = { "" + (:name ?? "") },
                        cap = { ("" + (:name ?? "")) == "" ? "Unassigned" : "" + :name },
                        n = { (:n ?? 0) + 0 },
                        peak = { (:peak ?? 1) + 0 },
                        hueName = { "" + (:name ?? "") },
                        on = { app.fAssignee != "" && app.fAssignee == ("" + (:name ?? "")) },
                        av: Avatar [ x = 4, y = 4, width = 20, height = 20, cornerRadius = 10, name = { "" + (:name ?? "") } ]
                        ]
                    ],

                closed14: View [ width = 100%,
                    datapath = { app.closedSeries.value },
                    cap: Text [ x = 0, y = 0, fontSize = 11, fontWeight = semibold, letterSpacing = 0.6, wrap = false,
                        textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }, text = "CLOSED · LAST 14 DAYS" ],
                    bars: View [ x = 0, y = 22, width = 100%, height = 40,
                        pk: number = { Math.max(1, (:peak ?? 1) + 0) },
                        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 3 ],
                        View [ datapath = :days[], width = { (this.parent.width - 39) / 14 },
                            height = 40,
                            b: View [ x = 0, cornerRadius = 1.5,
                                width = 100%,
                                y = { 40 - Math.max(2, 38 * (:@ + 0) / this.parent.parent.pk) },
                                height = { Math.max(2, 38 * (:@ + 0) / this.parent.parent.pk) },
                                fill = { app.statusColor("closed") } ]
                            ]
                        ]
                    ],

                perf: View [ width = 100%,
                    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 8 ],
                    cap: Text [ fontSize = 11, fontWeight = semibold, letterSpacing = 0.6, wrap = false,
                        textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }, text = "PERFORMANCE" ],
                    l1: View [ width = 100%, height = 16,
                        a: Text [ x = 0, y = 0, fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted }, text = "Initial load" ],
                        b: Text [ y = 0, fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textAlign = right, width = 70, x = end,
                            textColor = { provided("theme").text }, text = { app.loadMs + " ms" } ]
                        ],
                    l2: View [ width = 100%, height = 16,
                        a: Text [ x = 0, y = 0, fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted }, text = "Ingest" ],
                        b: Text [ y = 0, fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textAlign = right, width = 70, x = end,
                            textColor = { provided("theme").text }, text = { app.adoptMs + " ms" } ]

                    l3: View [ width = 100%, height = 16, visible = { app.query != "" },
                        a: Text [ x = 0, y = 0, fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted }, text = "Last search" ],
                        b: Text [ y = 0, fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textAlign = right, width = 70, x = end,
                            textColor = { provided("theme").text }, text = { (app.shown.value.searchMs ?? 0) + " ms" } ]
                        ]
                    ],

                keys: View [ width = 100%,
                    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 6 ],
                    cap: Text [ fontSize = 11, fontWeight = semibold, letterSpacing = 0.6, wrap = false,
                        textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }, text = "KEYBOARD" ],
                    KeyHint [ shortcut = "⌘K", what = "Search" ],
                    KeyHint [ shortcut = "↵", what = "Open selected row" ],
                    KeyHint [ shortcut = "⌫", what = "Delete selection" ],
                    KeyHint [ shortcut = "esc", what = "Close · clear" ],
                    tail: View [ width = 1, height = 8 ]
                    ]
                ]
            ]
        ],

    // ── the footer — the quiet ledger line: how many, how many shown ──────

    foot: View [ width = 100%, height = 32, padding = [0, 16, 0, 24],
        fill = { provided("theme").surface }, stroke = { [stroke(1, provided("theme").line), null, null, null] },
        stats: Text [ y = center, fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint },
            text = { app.issuesOf().length.toLocaleString() + " issues   ·   " + app.shownTotal.toLocaleString() + " shown" } ],
        perf: Text [ y = center, fontSize = 10.5, wrap = false, visible = { app.booted && !app.railOn },
            x = end,
            textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint },
            text = { "load " + app.loadMs + " ms · adopt " + app.adoptMs + " ms" } ]
        ],

    toast: Toast [ ignoreLayout = true, x = center,
        y = { app.height - 84 + (1 - this.lift) * 20 } ],

    // the entry screen — honest states for the one fetch

    entry: View [ visible = { !app.booted }, ignoreLayout = true, x = 0, y = 0, width = { app.width }, height = { app.height },
        fill = { provided("theme").background },
        col: View [ x = center, y = { app.height * 0.38 }, width = 220,
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 10 ],
            Text [ fontSize = 22, fontWeight = semibold, textAlign = center, width = 220,
                textFill = { gradient("90deg", provided("theme").accent, provided("theme").brandTeal) }, text = "Tracker" ],
            Text [ fontSize = 12.5, textAlign = center, width = 220, textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted },
                text = { app.src.failed ? "Could not load issues.json" : "Loading issues…" } ]
            ]
        ]
    ]
